company.name: Rosebud Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Rosebud Biosciences is a biotech company that develops medicines for uncommon genetic illnesses in children.
company.description:
Rosebud Biosciences is a biotech company that develops medicines for uncommon genetic illnesses in children. They collaborate with pharmaceutical firms to evaluate their products and conduct their own drug development for rare illnesses with no known therapies.

Rosebud Biosciences is headquartered in San Carlos, California and was founded in 2020.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that models genetic diseases using micropatterned organoids derived from patient-specific human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) to replicate genetic mutations for drug screening.
productsAndServices.name: Organoid Platform

productsAndServices.description: Organoids that model heart tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to study cardiac genetic diseases and screen potential therapies.
productsAndServices.name: Cardiac Organoids

productsAndServices.description: Organoids that replicate liver tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations for studying hepatic genetic diseases and evaluating treatments.
productsAndServices.name: Hepatic Organoids

productsAndServices.description: Organoids that model neural tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to investigate neurological genetic diseases and test therapies.
productsAndServices.name: Neural Organoids

productsAndServices.description: Developing organoids that model kidney tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to study renal genetic diseases and support drug discovery.
productsAndServices.name: Kidney Organoids (In Progress)
